description: Header file defining the ConnectTunnel class for managing a connection tunneled over a CONNECT proxy in the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: ConnectTunnel
classes.description: Manages a single connection tunneled over a CONNECT proxy, handling connection setup, data transfer, and connection closure.

methods.name: ConnectTunnel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ConnectTunnel with request handler, socket factory, and acceptable destinations.

methods.name: OpenTunnel
methods.description: Attempts to open a TCP connection to the destination server using headers from a CONNECT request.

methods.name: IsConnectedToDestination
methods.description: Checks if the connection to the destination server is currently active.

methods.name: SendDataToDestination
methods.description: Sends data to the destination server.

methods.name: OnClientStreamClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the client stream is closed.

methods.name: ConnectComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of connection attempt.

methods.name: ReceiveComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when data is received from the destination.

methods.name: SendComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when data has been sent.

methods.name: BeginAsyncReadFromDestination
methods.description: Starts asynchronous read from the destination socket.

methods.name: OnDataReceivedFromDestination
methods.description: Handles data received from the destination.

methods.name: OnDestinationConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles closure of the destination connection.

methods.name: SendConnectResponse
methods.description: Sends a response after attempting to connect.

methods.name: TerminateClientStream
methods.description: Terminates the client stream with an error message and code.
